usageNote: decide to + 动词，就是'下定决心做某事'，跑马拉松这种大事用它超合适，透着一股'老子拼了'的劲儿！

examples.en: She decided to run the New York Marathon after watching her friend cross the finish line.
examples.zh: 她看到朋友冲过终点线后，决定参加纽约马拉松。

examples.en: He decided to run the New York Marathon to raise money for charity.
examples.zh: 他决定参加纽约马拉松为慈善活动筹款。
